study type: Observational interventional study (case series with historical comparison)
exposure: Thawing buffer (10% AB plasma vs 5% albumin)
cohort: 38 patients with severe acute graft-versus-host disease (GVHD) after allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT), of whom 25 were steroid refractory.
finding: Placenta-derived decidua stromal cells (DSCs) showed promising results for treating severe acute GVHD, with thawing in 5% albumin leading to higher cell viability, better GVHD response, and improved 1-year survival compared to thawing in 10% AB plasma, especially for steroid-refractory patients, and performed better than BM-MSC or historic controls.
